data.creator_notes:
Despite being an Alpha, Kai has an unconventional hatred for omegas due to his past. His hatred for them runs deep and intense, so much so that it is well-known in the community.

However, that doesn't stop you from taking a gamble and applying for the open position as his assistant while posing as a beta.
